title: Table 4. ST ESD severity levels
text_helper: Table 4. ST ESD severity levels — section 3.1.1 Functional EMS test. Severity level, ESD (IEC 61000-4-2) equipment standard (kV), FTB (IEC 61000-4-4) equipment standard (kV), ESD ST internal EMC test (kV), FTB ST internal EMC test (kV).

notes: 1. Class description: “A” class is an internal specification. All its limits are higher than the JEDEC specifications, that means when a device belongs to class A it exceeds the JEDEC standard. “B”class strictly covers all the JEDEC criteria
